title: Filler: Shino's Beetles
later: ...Not now. You are busy. I can tell. Why? Your footsteps are hurried.

offer.speaker: shino
offer.text: A rare beetle has been seen in the trees by the training ground. Three of them, in three trees.

offer.speaker: shino
offer.text: Would you watch for them with me? Why ask you? Because insects hide from me when I am too eager.

steps.bar: Waiting for the beetle to come out
steps.text: Watch for the beetles in the trees by the training ground

dialogue.speaker: shino
dialogue.text: ...All three. You were patient. Most people aren't.

dialogue.speaker: shino
dialogue.text: Am I smiling? No. Why would you think that?
